name: Reviewers get trials
ownerWords:
can you do daily check for the review as well?

review free trial thing i mean
goal: Every real review post on slack.green gets a trial decision within 24 h: 14 free days for a clear, real review, or the owner's call on a doubtful one. The owner's two test posts do not count.

metrics.label: Review posts waiting over a day for a trial decision
Data sources that failed in this check

onMiss: source_errors: fix the precheck or SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY in slack-green scripts/seo-agent/.env first. Else open each waiting or new review's screenshot URL and read its text. For a clear, real review, grant 14 days with Grant on slack.green/admin/manage in the owner's Aside session (POST /api/admin/manage, action grant_trial with thread_id), then check that trial_extension_days and trial_ends_at changed. Put a doubtful or negative review on the owner's For you todo with its screenshot and text. Never email or message the reviewer. With nothing waiting, end with no message.
